_comment: Conformance corpus expectations — one entry per row of design.md's
failure-isolation table. Each case names the exact finding codes and the
specification clause each finding must cite, so a change in behaviour shows
up here as a data diff rather than buried in assertion code. This file is
the artifact that makes CAO's Agent Plugins conformance reviewable rather
Fields: loadable, skills (exact discovered names, sorted), mcp_present, and
findings as {code: spec_ref} pairs that must appear exactly once each.
'exact_findings': false means additional findings are tolerated; the
default (absent) means the listed set must be the complete set.

manifest-missing.row: plugin.json missing → plugin rejected; nothing published

manifest-missing-name.row: plugin.json missing a required field → plugin rejected

manifest-unsupported-schema.row: unrecognized $schema → plugin rejected, unsupported version reported

manifest-bad-name.row: name violating the §5.5 constraints → plugin rejected

manifest-unknown-field.row: unknown top-level manifest field → non-fatal, reported, ignored

extensions-not-object.row: extensions not an object → non-fatal, reported, ignored

extensions-unimplemented-namespace.row: extensions namespace CAO does not implement → ignored WITHOUT validating contents, no finding at all

skills-not-a-directory.row: skills exists but is not a directory → skills type invalid, MCP unaffected

skills-absent.row: missing fixed component location is not an error

skill-invalid-sibling.row: one skill invalid among N → that skill skipped, other N−1 delivered

skill-missing-skill-md.row: skill directory with no SKILL.md → that skill skipped with a report

skill-escapes-root.row: SKILL.md symlink escaping the plugin root → that skill skipped

skill-symlink-inside-root.row: symlink whose target resolves within the root is permitted

mcp-present.row: mcp.json present, Increment 1 → reported unsupported; skills still deliver

mcp-invalid.row: mcp.json invalid → MCP disabled for that plugin; skills still deliver. Increment 1 never reads the file, so its contents cannot change the outcome.
